description: A teal-colored table lamp with a decorative lampshade. The lampshade is conical, featuring vertical pleats and small, evenly spaced decorative beads along the pleats. The base of the lamp is round and flat, supporting a slender, curved stem that connects to the lampshade. The stem has a distinctive, artistic loop design, adding a touch of elegance and uniqueness to the overall form. The color is a solid, matte teal, giving it a clean and modern aesthetic.
